messages:
Nora T: rolling out 1% canary for redwood-v4q2 on /summarize. please watch slices: docs-longform, legal-briefs.
Diego R: ack. any known issues from bench?
Nora T: perf profile looks good, small p99 +60ms. offline eval shows a tiny rise in near-duplicate endings on longform docs (~0.6% abs).
Priya M: we don't have a behavioural gate enabled for /summarize yet right?
Nora T: correct. proposing a temporary gate: rollback if dedupe_inc >1.0% abs OR semantic_embed_cos_drop >1.0% OR p99_lat_delta >150ms.
Diego R: add a soft-sum rule too: (length_std_rel*0.5 + rouge_drop*0.7 + small_rep_rate*1.0) >= 1.0 triggers rollback. allows paired weak signals to trip.
ops-bot: rollout-bot: canary redwood-v4q2 started at 1745006789 route=["/summarize"] size=1% policy=gradual
Nora T: starting a replay of 1k recent requests against baseline+variant, will post diffs.
Priya M: also increase shadowing to 5% for 2h during this canary.
ops-bot: replay-job: replay-1745006789 started samples=1000
Diego R: quick local note: tokenizer merges for long legal docs caused off-by-one in one model we saw earlier; flag those examples in the replay.
ops-bot: replay-job: replay-1745006789 completed, dedupe_inc_overall=0.7%, legal-briefs_slice=1.2%, rouge_drop_legal=1.1%
Nora T: legal-briefs hit our absolute threshold -> initiating rollback on /summarize.
ops-bot: rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-v4q2 on /summarize at 1745007042 by @Nora T
Priya M: filing ENG-RUNTIME ticket for quant-tokenizer alignment + attaching replay artifacts. will follow up with a preflight test for prefix-consistency.
Diego R: agree on adding behavioural gate to rollout defaults for summarization routes.
Nora T: thanks team — will re-onboard after tokenization fix and a 24h shadow run.
